EventItemActionText:
BOARD OF ARCHITECTURAL REVIEW

The Board of Architectural Review met in a regular session on Thursday, June 18,  2026, at 7:30 p.m. in Town Hall, 127 Center St S, Vienna, VA 22180.
Roll Call: Ms. Couchman, Ms. Shelly, Mr. Penati, and Ms. Hanley were present. Mr. O’Keefe was absent.

Staff present: Planner Sharmaine Abaied, and Board Clerk Jennifer Murphy.

Item No. 1: Request approval of a revision to a wall sign located at 421 Maple Ave E., Docket No. PF-2142888-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East zoning district; filed by Justin Stegall, Bakeshop Vienna, Project Contact.

Applicant present: Justin Stegall

Mr. Stegall stated the second sign was proposed to have all lower case.  The Board members were amenable to the change.

There were no public comments.

Ms. Shelly made a motion to approve a revision to a wall sign located at 421 Maple Ave E., Docket No. PF-2142888-BAR, in the AE, Avenue East zoning district; filed by Justin Stegall, Bakeshop Vienna, Project Contact, as submitted.

Motion: Mr. Shelly
Second: Ms. Couchman 
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)
EventItemTitle: 421 Maple Ave W - Bakeshop - Sign Revision

EventItemActionText:
Item No. 2: Request approval of a wall sign and tenant panel for Weird Brothers Coffee located at 106 Lawyers Rd NW., Docket No. PF-2126681-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Ken Padgett, Mid-Atlantic Permitting, Project Contact.

Applicant Present: Ken Padgett

The applicant proposed an illuminated wall sign and tenant panel for Weird Brothers Coffee. Board members discussed the placement of the wall sign relative to the building architecture and requested that the sign be centered within the gable and aligned with the building’s architectural features. 

There were no public comments.

Ms. Penati made a motion to approve a wall sign and tenant panel for Weird Brothers Coffee located at 106 Lawyers Rd NW., Docket No. PF-2126681-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Ken Padgett, Mid-Atlantic Permitting, Project Contact, with the condition the sign is centered between the gable and keystone.

Motion: Ms. Penati
Second: Ms. Couchman
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)
EventItemTitle: 106 Lawyers Rd NW - Weird Brothers Coffee - Signs

EventItemActionText:
Item No. 3: Request approval of new wall signs for Mashahweez located at 126 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-2182471-BAR, in the AC Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Marviin Martinez, District Signs LLC, Project Contact.

Applicants Present: Abduhl Alshawi, William Amaya

The applicant proposed new wall signs for Mashahweez Shawarma and Grill. The Board discussed sign materials, illumination, colors, and readability. Board members found the proposal compatible with the building and surrounding commercial area. No public comments were received..

Ms. Couchman made a motion to approve new wall signs for Mashahweez located at 126 Maple Ave W, Docket No. PF-2182471-BAR, in the AC Avenue Center zoning district; filed by Marviin Martinez, District Signs LLC, Project Contact as submitted

Motion: Ms. Couchman
Second: Ms. Shelly
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried  (4-0)

Item No. 4: Request approval of a new monument sign for Vienna Family Dentist located at 212 Park St SE., Docket No. PF-2022408-BAR, in the RMU, Residential Multi Unit zoning district; filed by Keyvan Yousefi, D’Impression Sign, Project Contact.

Applicants Present:  Keyvan Yousefi

The applicant proposed replacement of an existing monument sign with a new aluminum and acrylic monument sign. Board discussion focused on the proposed color scheme, readability, and overall appearance. The Board recommended using a more neutral color for the “212 Park Street” lettering and simplifying the website address to improve readability. 

There were no public comments. 

Mr. Shelly made a motion to approve a new monument sign for Vienna Family Dentist located at 212 Park St SE., Docket No. PF-2022408-BAR, in the RMU, Residential Multi Unit zoning district; filed by Keyvan Yousefi, D’Impression Sign, Project Contact.with the following conditions:
•	"212 Park St" be changed to the color black.
•	"www" from the weight loss clinic URL be removed.

Motion: Ms. Shelly
Second: Mr. Penati
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)
EventItemTitle: 212 Park St SE- Vienna Family Dentist - Sign

EventItemActionText:
Item No. 5: Request approval of new lights for Berstein Management located at 226 Maple Ave E, Docket No. PF-2122081-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center Zoning district, filed by Wasif Sharoon, Berstein Management Group project contact.

Applicants Present:  Wasif Sharron

The applicant presented a request for approval of replacement LED lighting fixtures installed at the property. Board members discussed lighting intensity, color temperature, impacts on adjacent residential properties, and potential alternatives to fixture replacement, including dimming controls and light filters.

The Board determined that additional information was needed regarding the existing fixture specifications, operating levels, and available options for reducing light intensity. No public comments were received.

There were no public comments.

Ms. Couchman made a motion to defer the request for approval of new lights for Berstein Management located at 226 Maple Ave E, Docket No. PF-2122081-BAR, in the AC, Avenue Center Zoning district, filed by Wasif Sharoon, Berstein Management Group project contact.for the reasons listed below:
•	Gather more information about options to decrease the light intensity using dimmers and filters
•	Provide more information on the lighting lumens, watts, and kelvins.

Motion: Ms. Couchman
Second: Mr. Penati
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)
EventItemTitle: 226 Maple Ave E - Bernstein Management - Exterior Modifications

EventItemActionText:
Item No. 6: Request approval for new signs and exterior modifications for Moss located at 108 Church ST NE, Docket No. PF-2152462-BAR, in the CS, Church Street zoning district, filed by Ranwa Nourieh of Moss Construction, project contact.

Applicants Present:  Ranwa Nourieh and Kristen Corbett

The wall sign and the canopy sign were the first items discussed with the applicant along with the gooseneck lights for the sign. Next, the Board members discussed the revised architectural details, window proportions, trim treatments, and consistency of design elements throughout the building. The Board expressed support for the proposed improvements and discussed a minor modification to the front elevation window trim detail. No public comments were received. 

There were no public comments.

Ms. Shelly made a motion to approve the signs for Moss located at 108 Church ST NE, Docket No. PF-2152462-BAR, in the CS, Church Street zoning district, filed by Ranwa Nourieh of Moss Construction, project contact, as submitted

Motion: Ms. Shelly
Second: Mr. Penati
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)

Ms. Shelly made a motion to approve exterior modifications for Moss located at 108 Church ST NE, Docket No. PF-2152462-BAR, in the CS, Church Street zoning district, filed by Ranwa Nourieh of Moss Construction, project contact, with the following conditions:
•	The most recent submittal of sheet A003 be approved and
•	The two windows with shutters on the front elevation have the center mullion painted black.

Motion: Ms. Shelly
Second: Mr. Penati
Absent: Mr. O’Keefe
Motion Carried (4-0)
EventItemTitle: 108 Church St NE - Moss - Signs and Exterior Modifications

Meeting adjourned at approximately 9:25
-Sharmaine Abaied, Planner
